papers.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
papers.desc: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events.

papers.title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
papers.desc: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments.

papers.title: Super Library Agent: Joint Generation and Maintenance of Multiple Applications Beyond the Single Codebase
papers.desc: Organizations often develop and maintain portfolios of related applications: independently deployable codebases that share substantial domain logic, interface patterns, or operational conventions.

papers.title: Evaluating the Hidden Costs of Personalization in Large Language Models
papers.desc: While Large language models (LLMs) incorporate user personalization signals to improve usability and helpfulness, they increasingly shift from providing balanced, informative responses toward optimizing for user satisfaction when conditioned on personal context such as conversation history, inferred preferences, and user profiles.

papers.title: Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation
papers.desc: Latent diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for high-fidelity image and video synthesis, operating in compact latent spaces with variational autoencoders (VAEs) to enhance computational efficiency without compromising visual quality.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
papers.desc: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer.

papers.title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code
papers.desc: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works.

papers.title: ContextBias: Controlled Evaluation of Bias Persistence Under Context Shift in Text-to-Image Models
papers.desc: Text-to-image models learn associations between concepts - in the case of this paper, people's professions, which we refer to as roles - and visual attributes.

papers.title: SafeAtlas-VL: Beyond Binary Multimodal Safety with Large-Scale Data and Guard Models
papers.desc: Multimodal safety moderation requires distinguishing risks arising from visual content, user intent, and assistant behavior.

papers.title: EvoGenUI-Bench: Evaluating LLMs as Multi-Turn Generative UI Assistants
papers.desc: Large language models can generate interactive web interfaces, but reliable generative UI requires maintaining an executable artifact as user requests evolve.

papers.title: Chat-Edit-3D++: Interactive 3D and 4D Scene Editing via Large Language Models
papers.desc: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing.

papers.title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
papers.desc: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

papers.title: MMMMM: A Unified Taxonomy for Investigating the Mechanisms of Multilingual MultiModal Misinformation
papers.desc: Multimodal misinformation on social media is highly prevalent, potent, and harmful, yet difficult to detect and counter, and still poorly understood compared to its text-only counterpart.

papers.title: SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware End-to-End AI Weather Forecasting: Disentangling Observation and Model Contributions
papers.desc: End-to-end weather forecasting systems produce skillful global gridded and station forecasts directly from raw Earth observations, replacing the numerical weather prediction pipeline, including data assimilation, at a fraction of its cost.
